component_evaluations.label: Meaningful reciprocal rubbing
component_evaluations.evaluation: No two readable reciprocal palm strokes are established. Small lather/edge changes accompany an almost held hand-contact pose.

component_evaluations.label: Low connected palm/arm contact
component_evaluations.evaluation: Both forearms remain connected and low palms maintain contact above the basin. Partial soap occlusion and absence of a readable slide keep this distinct from accepted washing.

component_evaluations.label: Attention and face
component_evaluations.evaluation: The fresh source clearly looks down toward the joined hands; that attention remains through all41 frames. This is a reference opinion, not a repair of the current game attention3.8.

component_evaluations.label: Hair/headwear/face identity
component_evaluations.evaluation: The pink headband, cream shell-flower, brown curls/trailing rainbow and simplified child face remain recognizable. Late phantom material beside the head is separately rejected.

component_evaluations.label: Costume/tail/paint stability
component_evaluations.evaluation: The main apron/gingham/tail contours and colors stay recognizable, but pocket/star and scale/highlight shimmer remain. No seamless source-family or gameplay transition is established.

component_evaluations.label: Tap/basin/lather/material truth
component_evaluations.evaluation: From the middle, extra pale traces change the tap/rim. From26 the new white arc grows beside the head, ending as a tall head-to-basin arch. This is not contained hand lather or an off-tap fixture.

component_evaluations.label: Entry/exit continuity
component_evaluations.evaluation: Entry retains source contact; exit adds a large invented white arch. The take cannot return cleanly to its source or claim a loop.
